Paired with the Qilive connected scale Q.5033, the application easily measures and stores your personal body condition data such as the muscle mass percentage, weight, fat percentage,bone mass percentage, hydration percentage...

Based on the height analysis, weight, and age, the application can tell you your daily energy requirement and helps control your weight.
With Bluetooth 4.0 technology you can track and store your data on mobile devices. 

The application's features are numerous:

• calculate many parameters (muscle percentage, fat rate, bone mass levels, moisture levels)
• create up to 12 custom profiles
• show regularly monitor your weight curve through graphics
• achieve your set goals more easily
• share your achievements on social networks
• calculate your best daily caloric intake
